name: student-task-manager-cicd-reporting
description: Student Task Manager with Playwright E2E Testing, Allure Reporting, and GitHub Actions CI/CD Pipeline

scripts.report:all: npm run allure:generate && npm run test:report
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['allure-results', 'allure-report', 'playwright-report', 'test-results'].forEach(d => { if (fs.existsSync(d)) fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }); }); console.log('All reports and artifacts cleaned successfully.');"

author: SWT301 - Student Task Manager Team
